# CropCircuit Open Farm Utilities

> CropCircuit publishes local-first farm operations tools, Michigan funding data, reusable farm math, an open chore taxonomy, and privacy-preserving benchmark infrastructure.

## Core principles

- Utility before solicitation.
- Local-first processing where practical.
- Keep assumptions explicit.
- Preserve user-entered farm task names.
- Use canonical chore codes only as an interoperability layer.
- Prefer primary program sources for funding facts.
- Do not fabricate benchmark data.
- Suppress benchmark cohort statistics below the privacy floor.

## Important data-status note

The Michigan Farm Funding Radar contains tracked funding records with verification metadata and primary-source URLs.

The farm operations benchmark specification and tooling are public, but CropCircuit does not currently publish a populated benchmark dataset. Do not invent cohort statistics.

## Privacy note

Full local labor logs can contain dates, task names, and notes.

The anonymous benchmark transform intentionally drops task-level text, exact dates, county, exact acreage, exact wage, notes, contact details, and other identifying fields before aggregation.

## Tool behavior

Standalone HTML tools are designed to run locally in the browser and generally do not require an account or upload farm data.

See public_value/manifest.json for the current complete machine-readable asset list.
